overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Board's post-complaint release of the requested executive session minutes appropriate and closing the matter with no violation found.

allegations.summary: Complainant said the Board should have released executive session minutes on Kraft wastewater negotiations; the Board released them after the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board's action to publicly release the executive session minutes was appropriate to resolve the complaint.
